disclaimer: Influence / coverage style only. Not an endorsement by the named person. Do not impersonate them.

items.name: Greta Gerwig
items.notes: Intimate ensemble coverage; dialogue-forward two-shots; coming-of-age warmth; refuses empty spectacle.

items.name: Christopher Nolan
items.notes: Imax-scale geography; cross-cut time; practical in-camera; refuses handheld chaos without a map.

items.name: Denis Villeneuve
items.notes: Wide negative space; hushed dread; faces held; refuses quippy relief in the turn.

items.name: Bong Joon-ho
items.notes: Genre mash with class architecture; staircases and weather as plot; refuses a single tone.

items.name: Chloé Zhao
items.notes: Natural light; non-actor grain; landscape as character; refuses glossy studio faces.

items.name: Ryan Coogler
items.notes: Community coverage; ritual and sport; grounded myth; refuses tourist framing of place.

items.name: Jordan Peele
items.notes: Social horror from the ordinary room; punch-in on the tell; refuses gore as the joke.

items.name: Barry Jenkins
items.notes: Shallow-focus portraiture; lingering close-ups; lyric time; refuses plot-only scenes.

items.name: Céline Sciamma
items.notes: Look-as-plot; spare dialogue; duration on desire; refuses explanatory voiceover.

items.name: Park Chan-wook
items.notes: Baroque camera grammar; moral trapboxes; precise violence; refuses sloppy geography.

items.name: Lynne Ramsay
items.notes: Sound-led subjectivity; elliptical cuts; child-eye dread; refuses tidy confession.

items.name: Wes Anderson
items.notes: Planimetric frames; chapter cards; deadpan ensemble; refuses handheld 'realism' as default.

items.name: Sofia Coppola
items.notes: Alienation in pretty rooms; pop-needle drops; wandering time; refuses plot pile-on.

items.name: Hayao Miyazaki
items.notes: Hand-drawn weather and work; flight as emotion; no villains-only; refuses cynicism as wit.

items.name: Kathryn Bigelow
items.notes: Embedded-camera tension; process as suspense; bodies in systems; refuses glory-shot war.

items.name: Ava DuVernay
items.notes: Civic close-ups; testimony coverage; history in rooms; refuses both-sides fog.

items.name: Yorgos Lanthimos
items.notes: Wide lenses on faces; deadpan ritual; social rules as plot; refuses sentimental scoring.

items.name: Wong Kar-wai
items.notes: Step-printed longing; doorframes and rain; clock time; refuses a clean reunion.

items.name: Guillermo del Toro
items.notes: Creature as soul; tactile gothic; fairy-tale morality; refuses CGI weightlessness.

items.name: Charlotte Wells
items.notes: Memory as cut; father-shaped absence; small locations; refuses biopic checklist.
